WITH award_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award
    GROUP BY player_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count
    FROM award_counts
)
SELECT award_counts.player_id,
       award_counts.award_count,
       award_counts.award_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(totals.total_count, 0) AS fraction
FROM award_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
